cases.sentence: Ной и его сыновья — Сим, Хам и ___.
cases.explain: Афет is listed as a subject alongside Shem and Ham in nominative case.

cases.sentence: Сыновья Иофеты — Гомер, Магок, Мадай, Иован, Тувал, Мешех и ___.
cases.explain: Терас is listed as one of the sons in nominative case.

cases.sentence: Куш был отцом ___, который стал первым на земле могучим воином.
cases.explain: The verb 'был отцом' (was the father of) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: У Арпахшада родился ___, а у Шелаха родился Евер.
cases.explain: Шелах is the subject of the verb 'родился' (was born) in nominative case.

cases.sentence: Сим, Арпахшат, Шулах, Евер, Пеле, Креу, Сирук, Нагор, Тирах, ___.
cases.explain: Авраам is listed as the final person in this genealogical sequence in nominative case.

cases.sentence: Авраам был отцом ___, сыновья Исаака — Исаф и Израиль.
cases.explain: The phrase 'был отцом' (was the father of) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Сыновья Исаава — Элифаз, Рагуил и Иуш, Ялам и ___.
cases.explain: Корах is listed as one of Esau's sons in nominative case.

cases.sentence: Вот цари, которые правили в Идоме еще до того, как в Израиле появились ___.
cases.explain: цари is the subject of the verb 'появились' (appeared/arose) in nominative case.

reading.ru: Ной и его сыновья — Сим, Хам и Афет.
reading.question: Who were the sons of Noah?
reading.explain: The text states 'Ной и его сыновья — Сим, Хам и Афет' (Noah and his sons were Shem, Ham, and Japheth).

reading.ru: Куш был отцом Инемрода, который стал первым на земле могучим воином.
reading.question: Who was Nimrod, and what was he known for?
options: Nimrod was the son of Cush and became a mighty warrior on the earth
Nimrod was a king of Egypt
Nimrod was the son of Abraham
reading.correct: Nimrod was the son of Cush and became a mighty warrior on the earth
reading.explain: The text says 'Куш был отцом Инемрода, который стал первым на земле могучим воином' (Cush was the father of Nimrod, who became a mighty warrior on the earth).

reading.ru: У Евера родилось двое сыновей, одного звали Пелек, потому что в его дни земля была разделена, а его брата — Иоктан.
reading.question: Why was Eber's son named Peleg?
options: Because in his days the earth was divided
Because he was the first king
Because he built the tower of Babel
Because he was a great warrior
reading.correct: Because in his days the earth was divided
reading.explain: The text states that Peleg was named this 'потому что в его дни земля была разделена' (because in his days the earth was divided).

reading.question: Who were the sons of Abraham?
reading.explain: The text clearly states 'Сыновья Авраама, Исаак и Измаил' (The sons of Abraham, Isaac and Ishmael).

reading.ru: Авраам был отцом Исаака, сыновья Исаака — Исаф и Израиль.
reading.question: What relationship did Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob/Israel have?
options: Abraham was the father of Isaac, and Isaac was the father of Esau and Israel
Isaac was the father of Abraham
Isaac and Israel were the same person
reading.correct: Abraham was the father of Isaac, and Isaac was the father of Esau and Israel
reading.explain: The text states the genealogy: 'Авраам был отцом Исаака, сыновья Исаака — Исаф и Израиль' (Abraham was the father of Isaac, and the sons of Isaac were Esau and Israel).

reading.ru: Вот цари, которые правили в Идоме еще до того, как в Израиле появились цари.
reading.question: What does the text say about the kings of Edom in relation to the kings of Israel?
options: The kings of Edom reigned before any king reigned over Israel
The kings of Israel ruled before the kings of Edom
The kings of Edom and Israel ruled at the same time
No kings ever ruled in Edom
reading.correct: The kings of Edom reigned before any king reigned over Israel
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'цари, которые правили в Идоме еще до того, как в Израиле появились цари' (kings who reigned in Edom before any king arose in Israel).
